problems.quote: The reasoning section usually carries 30‑35 questions to be solved in 30‑35 minutes
problems.problem: Major Indian railway recruitment exams (RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP) have a composite time limit (typically 90 minutes for 100 questions) with no separate sectional timing for reasoning; the claim of a dedicated 30‑35 minute block is inaccurate.
problems.correction: The reasoning section usually carries 30‑35 questions within a composite test duration of about 90 minutes
problems.verifierReason: Original falsely claims dedicated sectional timing; RRB NTPC/Group D/ALP use composite 90-min limit. Correction accurately reflects pattern.

problems.quote: the numeric coordinate increments by 1 across each row and resets per row

problems.correction: the numeric coordinate increments by 1 across each row and continues across rows
problems.verifierReason: Original says resets per row; example shows continuous 1-9. Correction correctly states continues across rows.
